description:
The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.
Digitech is a leading provider of advanced billing and technology services to the EMS transport industry. Since its founding in 1984, Digitech has refined its software platform to create a cloud-based billing and business intelligence solution that monitors and automates the entire EMS revenue lifecycle. Digitech leverages its proprietary technology to offer fully outsourced services that maximize collections, protect compliance, and deliver results for clients.
Summary:
The Credit Balance Specialist plays a vital role in Digitech’s revenue cycle operations by ensuring that all refunds are processed accurately, timely, and in full compliance with payer regulations and organizational policies. This position is responsible for reviewing, validating, and posting refund transactions; coordinating with payers, attorneys, and government entities; and maintaining exceptional accuracy in financial records.
The ideal candidate is detail oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working in a fast paced environment that requires precision, strong mathematical skills, and regular communication with internal teams and external partners. This role directly contributes to Digitech’s commitment to compliance, transparency, and client satisfaction.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Receive, review, and process refund requests in accordance with payer rules, internal procedures, and regulatory requirements

• Accurately post and record refund transactions in the billing system, ensuring proper documentation and audit ready financial records

• Research account histories to verify refund validity, payment sources, EOB details, and overpayment rationale

• Communicate with external stakeholders, including attorneys, no fault carriers, workers’ compensation representatives, and the VA as needed to confirm refund details or request supporting documentation

• Interpret and understand Explanations of Benefits (EOBs) to determine refund justification and payment disposition

• Collaborate closely with internal teams, including Payment Posting, Billing, QA, and Client Services, to resolve discrepancies and ensure accurate account adjustments

• Ensure refunds are processed within required timeframes, meeting daily productivity goals and departmental service level expectations

• Maintain detailed, accurate notes documenting actions taken, communication, and financial adjustments

• Identify discrepancies, patterns, or repeat issues and escalate them to the Department Manager for resolution or process improvement

• Handle mail, emails, and refund correspondence, ensuring proper follow through and documentation

• Support compliance efforts, ensuring all refund processes meet HIPAA, payer, and internal standards

• Additional job duties as assigned

Skills/Experience Required:

• Education: High School Diploma or equivalent

• Strong ability to multi task and manage a high volume workload while maintaining accuracy

• Collaborative team player capable of working effectively across internal departments and with external partners

• Professional, pleasant, and confident demeanor in verbal and written communication

• Ability to remain calm, organized, and focused under pressure

• High computer literacy, including ease working with dual monitors and navigating multiple systems simultaneously

• Excellent follow through and problem solving abilities

• Strong mathematical skills and comfort handling financial calculations

• Proficiency in reading and interpreting Explanations of Benefits (EOBs)

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Ability to meet deadlines and maintain high productivity

• Previous experience handling refunds, payment posting, or medical billing is helpful

• Dependable, punctual, and accountable with a strong work ethic

• Ability to independently manage all aspects of the job rol

title: Product Management Lead, Communication Platform
description:

At Teladoc Health , you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

You will lead the evolution from distributed communications systems toward a scalable, data-driven orchestration platform that can support service communications, clinical nudges, onboarding journeys, communication preferences, and future AI-driven engagement.
A major focus on the role will be shaping Teladoc Health ’s next-generation communication automation and orchestration strategy, including evaluation and adoption of best-in-class platforms that enable this strategy. You’ll need enough product and technical fluency to separate narrow internal builds from true platform capabilities, influence vendor and architecture decisions, and ensure the chosen path supports both near-term delivery and long-term member engagement needs.

• Enable data-driven and AI-powered engagement: partner with data, AI, clinical, and product teams to support personalized nudges, journey-based messaging, suppression logic, segmentation, and next-best-action capabilities.

• Navigate complex stakeholders: operate as a credible senior product voice across marketing, DAI/data, engineering, clinical services, operations, legal/privacy, design, and executive leadership; synthesize competing priorities into a coherent product direction.

• Proven ability to build alignment and productively own feature direction without sacrificing empathy and collaboration with team contributors

• Ability to operate autonomously and handle ambiguity, including giving and receiving feedback despite that ambiguity

• Understanding of PvP game design and balance, getting the challenge level right for a wide variety of situations

• Understanding of how systemically consistent, combinatoric game design can create player surprise and laughter

• Outstanding oral and written communication skills

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

title: Talent Sourcer (Per-Qualified-Lead Contract) - Remote
description:
Engagement: 1099 contractor. Per-candidate-delivered fee. Location: Remote.
A note from the founder
Sourcing is the foundation of every recruiting motion that scales.
Most firms blur the line between sourcer and recruiter. The Wilkinson Firm separates them deliberately. Sourcers find. Recruiters close. Both get paid for what they actually do.
We are opening Talent Sourcer seats - contributors who deliver qualified candidates into the TWF pipeline at a per-candidate rate. Mission-aligned starter pay, real climb as you prove your sourcing quality.
What you would do

• Source candidates against TWF requisitions across HR Advisory, PHES, and GovCon practices

• Vet each candidate against the requisition's must-haves

• Deliver candidate packages: resume, sourcing notes, contact info, confirmed interest

• Maintain a sourcing log inside TWF's Manatal ATS

• Iterate on what is working - feedback from recruiters shapes your funnel

Compensation - Climbing Ladder
Stage 1 (first 90 days, mission-aligned starter):

• $15 per qualified candidate delivered (must meet must-haves + confirmed interest)

• Bonus: $25 per candidate that advances to first-round interview

Stage 2 (after 50 qualified deliveries + 30% interview advancement rate):

• $25 per qualified candidate

• $50 per candidate that advances to interview

• $250 per candidate that gets hired

Stage 3 (after 6 months + sustained quality):

• $50 per qualified candidate

• $100 per candidate that advances to interview

• 1% of first-year salary per candidate hired

• Senior sourcer / team lead conversation opens

Who we want

• 1-5 years dedicated sourcing experience

• Comfortable in LinkedIn Recruiter, hireEZ, SeekOut, or equivalent boolean-search tools

• Strong Manatal or ATS hygiene

• Documented sourcing quality - candidates you delivered who actually got hired

Bonus: Specialty in BH clinical, hospitality, or federal workforce.

title: Leiter Konzernrechnungswesen (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena digitalisiert die Hausverwaltung in Deutschland. Wir übernehmen traditionelle Hausverwaltungen und transformieren sie in moderne, technologiegetriebene Unternehmen, mit dem Ziel, Immobilienverwaltung einfach und transparent zu machen.

DEINE ROLLE

Du baust unser Rechnungswesen von Grund auf. Du entwickelst die Prozesse, gestaltest die Systeme und stellst Schritt für Schritt ein schlankes Team zusammen. Dabei arbeitest du selbst operativ mit und verantwortest korrekte HGB-Abschlüsse für alle Gesellschaften und für die Gruppe. Du berichtest direkt an den CFO. Unsere Gruppe wächst durch Zukäufe, und was du aufbaust, muss mit diesem Tempo mithalten. Du entscheidest, wie Rechnungswesen bei Buena funktioniert.

WAS DU TUN WIRST

- Aufbau. Du baust ein zentrales Rechnungswesen für alle deutschen Gesellschaften Schritt für Schritt auf. Dafür legst du Zielbild und Roadmap fest, übernimmst Aufgaben von externen Dienstleistern und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit ihnen.

- Prozesse. Du setzt einheitliche Prozesse von der Kreditorenbuchhaltung bis zum Jahresabschluss auf, inklusive festem Abschlusskalender, und reduzierst manuelle Schritte.

- Integration neuer Gesellschaften. Du baust die Systeme und Prozesse, mit denen wir neu erworbene Gesellschaften schnell und präzise integrieren.

- Systeme. Du verantwortest DATEV und LucaNet und gestaltest Datenmodell, Kontenplan, Mapping, Validierungen und Berechtigungen.

- Einzelabschlüsse. Du prüfst die Einzelabschlüsse aller Gesellschaften auf Richtigkeit und Termintreue, damit sie eine belastbare Basis für die Konsolidierung sind. Wo nötig, übernimmst du Abschlussbuchungen, Abstimmungen und Intercompany-Klärungen selbst.

- Konsolidierung. Du baust die HGB-Konsolidierung in LucaNet auf, mit monatlichen Konzernzahlen, die einer Prüfung standhalten, sowie Konzernkontenplan und Bilanzierungsrichtlinien.

- Prüfer und Berater. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Wirtschaftsprüfer und Steuerberater und setzt Prüfungsfeststellungen um.

- Team. Du baust das Team Schritt für Schritt auf und entscheidest, welche Aufgaben intern bleiben und welche extern vergeben werden.

DU PASST GUT ZU UNS, WENN

- Du hast Konzernabschlüsse nach HGB selbst erstellt, nicht nur koordiniert oder geprüft, am besten in einer Gruppe mit vielen Gesellschaften.

- Du bist LucaNet-Experte und hast eine Konsolidierung dort selbst neu aufgesetzt, von der Datenübernahme aus DATEV bis zum Reporting.

- Du beherrschst DATEV bis in die Tiefe und hast viele Mandanten mit einheitlicher Struktur aufgesetzt und geführt.

- Du hast ein Rechnungswesen mit Prozessen und Systemen selbst aufgebaut, nicht nur verbessert.

- Du hast ein Team aufgebaut und geführt.

- Du erkennst Fehler in Einzelabschlüssen, bevor sie in die Konsolidierung laufen.

- Du warst bei Abschlussprüfungen erste Ansprechperson und hast Feststellungen umgesetzt.

- Du arbeitest schnell und genau, auch unter Abschlussdruck.

- Du kommst in unklaren Situationen schnell ins Handeln.

- Du entwirfst Lösungen und setzt sie selbst um, ohne auf Vorlagen oder Zuarbeit zu warten.

- Du hast BWL, Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen studiert oder bist vergleichbar qualifiziert. Bilanzbuchhalter, Steuerfachwirt, Steuerberater oder Prüfer sind ein Vorteil.

- Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch.

WAS DU BEKOMMST

- Bis zu €500 Office-Nähe-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Office wohnst (oder hinziehst).

- €110 pro Monat Mittagessen-Budget und €50 pro Monat Fitness-Zuschuss.

- €1.200 jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

title: Intern, Quantum Applications
description:
PsiQuantum ’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers-machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.
Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.
Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry-including partners like GlobalFoundries-we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.
In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining-and that now is the time to scale.
PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies-including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical-to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.
Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift-and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.
Come join us.
Job Summary:
We are looking for enthusiastic candidates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world challenges. At PsiQuantum , we are particularly focused on use cases of quantum computing in chemistry, drug design, materials science, and fluid dynamics. Along these lines, we are offering internships in the areas of quantum algorithms and quantum compilation.
Your work could entail the -

• Development of quantum algorithms to solve impactful problems,

• Optimization of ubiquitous subroutines in fault tolerant quantum algorithms,

• Compilation of quantum algorithms to logical gate sets,

• Incorporation of architecture-aware optimizations,

• Estimation of quantum resources.

Prior work in the field of fault tolerant quantum algorithms and compilation is preferred, but enthusiasm for quantum computing is essential.
Desired experience and skills:

• Currently studying for, or completed a postgraduate degree related to quantum algorithms, quantum circuit compilation, fault tolerance or another aspect of quantum computing OR 5+ years working professionally in one or more of these fields.

• Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) and collaborative software development tools (e.g. Git).

• A creative and adaptable approach to problem solving.

• Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team.

Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote in the UK only.
Salary Range: £121,000 - £137,000 dependant on experience + stock options
Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.
We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!
About the Role
As Director of Analytics, you will own the full path from raw data to decision: the data warehouse, the transformation layer, and the BI tooling analysts and the business actually touch. You will set the technical direction for the analytics stack, lead a small team of analysts and analytics engineers, and be the person executive stakeholders come to for a straight answer backed by solid numbers.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage the team, but you are also expected to review models, dig into the warehouse yourself, and make the tooling calls, not just delegate them.
What We Are Looking For

• You are a rigorous thinker who treats data as evidence, not decoration, and holds your team to that same standard

• You have strong technical chops in SQL and the modern data stack (warehouse, transformation layer, BI layer), and you can go deep on any of them

• You have led or grown a team of analysts or analytics engineers, and you know how to hire, mentor, and set a bar

• You are comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems, from "what should we even be measuring" through to a shipped dashboard

• You communicate findings crisply to technical and non-technical audiences, including at the executive level

• You have opinions on BI tooling grounded in experience, not just familiarity, and can make a real build-vs-buy or migrate-vs-stay case

What You Will Be Doing

•
Own the analytics architecture end to end , from the Snowflake warehouse and dbt transformation layer through to the BI/reporting layer used across the business

•
Set and evolve BI tooling strategy , including evaluating whether our current tool, Sigma, remains the right fit versus alternatives like Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or Mode as the team and data volume grow

•
Lead, hire, and develop a team ofanalysts and analytics engineers

•
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Engineering to define key metrics, build self-serve reporting, and translate business questions into well-scoped analytical work

•
Establish data modeling standards, testing, and governance across dbt models so the numbers hold up under scrutiny

•
Own data security and access controls across the warehouse and BI layer, ensuring sensitive retail, store, and operational data is properly governed, access is scoped by role, and we meet our customers' data handling requirements

•
Build and own executive-facing reporting on core business metrics such as product availability, store performance, and inventory accuracy

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in analytics, with at least 3 years directly managing or leading a team

• Deep hands-on SQL, including complex CTEs, window functions, and query optimization

• Real experience running a cloud data warehouse, Snowflake strongly preferred

• Hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer

• Track record evaluating, migrating, or scaling BI tools, with the ability to speak concretely to tradeoffs between tools like Sigma, Looker, Tableau, and Power BI

• Experience translating messy operational data into decisions executives act on

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners without authority

• Comfortable operating remote-first, across a distributed team

Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.

• Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.

• Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.

• Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.

• Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.

• Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.

• Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.

• Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.

• Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.

• Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.

• Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.

• Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.

title: Localization Operations Manager (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We're looking for a Localization Operations Manager to audit and redesign how we conduct translation and localization end to end; from content creation, through engineering delivery, to linguistic quality review. You will challenge our current tooling and AI/MT workflows, content ownership and governance models, integrate AI software development best practices, and leave behind a better process and toolset for multiple language markets, not just one.

What you'll do

• Audit the current end-to-end localization and translation workflow for our three main markets, from source content definition through engineering execution to linguistic QA, defining and implementing improvements for an updated localization process. 

• Evaluate and evolve our use of machine translation and AI-assisted translation tooling, including glossary ownership and governance, content classification, and where and how human review fits in.

• Define a vendor and tooling strategy for translation and linguistic quality a cross our language markets; updating our existing tool stack as needed. 

• Design and roll-out evolved processes in partnership with engineering, design, product, medical, and local go-to-market teams

• Hand off a durable process and toolset by the end of the engagement.

 

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

• Prior experience as a Technical Program Manager, Product Manager, or Localization Operations Manager, with hands-on experience designing and implementing localization/internationalization tooling and MT/AI-assisted translation workflows.

• Strong proficiency in AI-native workflows as they relate to software development and content management. Can build tooling solutions, agents, and technical solutions where needed. 

• Experience with multi-market, multi-language products at scale. Italian, French or German localization experience is a plus.

• Track record of shipping quality, speed, or cost improvements to a localization or translation operation.

• Strong stakeholder management across design, engineering, and content teams.

• Comfortable working independently on a fixed-term, outcome-driven engagement.

• Professional working proficiency in English; fluency in Italian is a plus. 

Our interview process

• Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour)

• Case Study & Restitution

• Behavioral Interview (1h30)

• At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page .

Job details

• Short term position

• 9 months

• Paris or Berlin, France

• Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

• Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Controller
description:
About Ritual

Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.

About the role
We’re looking for a hands-on Controller to build and oversee our financial operations as we scale.
You’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team to manage all accounting, financial reporting, and compliance functions across both fiat and crypto assets.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and wants to help shape the financial foundation of a next-generation technology company.

•
Oversee all financial operations and serve as the internal owner for accounting, treasury, and financial reporting, while coordinating execution with external accounting and tax partners.

•
Maintain robust internal controls over fiat and digital assets, ensuring proper reconciliation, documentation, and authorization processes.

•
Manage company treasury , including crypto and fiat holdings, stablecoin liquidity, and vendor payments.

•
Monitor and report financial position , cash runway, and budget-to-actual performance for management and investors.

•
Own financial systems and process design , implementing efficient tools for expense tracking, payments, and internal reporting.

•
Coordinate financial reporting cycles (monthly/quarterly/annual close) with external partners to ensure timely and accurate statements.

•
Support token operations , including warrant tracking, token vesting, treasury management, and coordination with token administration platforms.

•
Collaborate with leadership on budgeting, forecasting, and scenario planning for both fiat and crypto assets.

•
Ensure compliance and risk management across all financial operations, including custody, KYC/AML practices, and digital asset handling.

•
Prepare investor and board materials , summarizing key financial metrics, burn, and strategic initiatives.

•
Partner with legal and finance teams to support fundraising, audits, and due diligence processes.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or equivalent preferred).

• 5+ years of accounting/finance experience, ideally including early-stage startups or fast-growth environments.

• Strong understanding of US GAAP and accounting best practices.

• Experience managing or reconciling crypto transactions and digital assets (DeFi, tokens, stablecoins, etc.).

• Familiarity with crypto-native tooling.

• Knowledge of AI or technology sector financial operations (e.g., cloud compute, SaaS, R&D capitalization).

• Proven ability to design and implement accounting processes in a startup setting.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to explain complex financial topics clearly.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently.

Why join us

• Join a passionate group of engineers, researchers, and operators on a mission to build the next generation of AI infrastructure

• Highly competitive compensation package, including annual discretionary bonus & optimized tax structure compared to the vast majority of web3 startups

• Top 1% of benefits across the web3 startup space

• 100% of premiums covered on highest quality healthcare

• Aggressive company 401k match

• Fully remote and/or hybrid, up to you!

• Participate in virtual and in-person events

• Much much more!

title: Senior HR Compliance & Escalations Specialist – EMEA
description:
About Remote People

At Remote People , we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams . By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button.

If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world , apply now!

We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

About the Role

Remote People is looking for a Senior HR Compliance & Escalations Specialist to join our EMEA Support team.

This is a senior, employee- and client-facing HR Operations role for someone who enjoys solving complex employment challenges, not simply routing questions to other teams. You will be the escalation point for high-priority cases that require sound judgement, strong compliance knowledge and calm, clear communication.

You will support a broad range of employee lifecycle matters, including contracts, leave, payroll and benefits queries, employee relations and offboarding. A key part of the role is being able to assess the situation, understand the local employment risk and provide a practical answer or recommendation directly. While you will partner closely with Payroll, Legal, Compliance and local providers when needed, you will take ownership of driving cases through to resolution.

You will also help strengthen the wider Support function by identifying recurring issues, improving processes and creating clear guidance that enables the team to prevent avoidable escalations.

This role is ideal for a hands-on HR Operations professional with strong multi-country EMEA compliance experience, particularly across Spain, France and German, who can confidently de-escalate sensitive employee or client concerns and deliver an excellent support experience in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Job Responsibilities

• Act as the senior escalation point for complex employee and client HR queries across EMEA, taking ownership from initial assessment through to a clear, compliant resolution.

• Provide practical, accurate guidance on employment compliance, contracts, leave, benefits, payroll-related queries, employee relations and offboarding.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Who is Shift?

Shift provides business finance to small and medium businesses (SMEs) in Australia, including Business Overdraft, Equipment Line, Asset Finance and Trade Account. Since 2014, Shift has funded more than 30,000 Australian businesses.

At Shift, our unique approach to product innovation combined with our collaborative culture means you can build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll be joining a diverse team of over 300 people who are always looking to deliver better outcomes for Australian businesses.

About the Role:

Join Shift's in house legal team for a dynamic, hands-on role where your work truly makes an impact. As Legal Counsel, you'll split your time between broad commercial contracts and advisory work, and our specialist recoveries practice covering collections, workouts, caveats, and debt recovery. The recoveries work is a niche skill set - and we’ll provide comprehensive training. Enjoy the benefits of working in a small, collaborative team with opportunities for continuous learning.

What You’ll Do:

- Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including supplier and merchant contracts

- Manage collections, workout, caveat and debt recovery matters

- Support loan, security and trade finance documentation

- Advise on HR matters and AFCA complaints

- Give practical, timely legal advice across the business

What You’ll Bring:

- 3 to 5 years’ PQE from a mid to top tier firm or financial services

- A current Australian practising certificate

- Strong drafting and negotiation skills

- Banking, lending or insolvency exposure highly regarded

- A commercial mindset and a willingness to learn a specialist area

- Hybrid working: we’re headquartered in North Sydney with state-based workplaces and offer a hybrid work policy. Our offices have spaces for collaboration, socialising and focused work.

If you don’t meet all the qualifications or skills but think you’d be a great fit, please apply anyway.

title: Cost Engineering / Control Opportunity - Project Controls - Energy Infrastructur
description:
Due to increased opportunities and demand in the Energy & Natural Resources division, the team are recruiting for Cost Engineers to join a diverse and supportive team during a period of significant growth. Our Energy client is at the forefront of industry leading change, and we are keen to speak to like-minded individuals with senior cost engineering experience to see what Turner & Townsend can offer you.
MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE
A Cost Engineer will be responsible for work packages and projects of varying size and complexity. Due to the nature of the programme of works, work packages may vary in size with Cost Engineers accountable for control of cost on multiple smaller projects or one which could be significantly larger in value. A Cost Engineer will be responsible for taking the lead on cost control for multiple non-related projects or single highly complex projects within the programme of works. They will understand and manage relationships between time, cost, risk, change, reporting and scope, with accountability for creating and maintaining robust cost controls and reports that provide our clients with accurate data to drive management decisions. They will play a key role in ensuring that client objectives are met and that projects are delivered to time and cost targets and the appropriate quality standards.
Key Accountabilities
As a Cost Engineer, you have a passion to provide services as required by our clients, which may include:

• Tailoring Cost Control approaches to meet the client’s needs and aligning with best practice.

• Implementing, administering, and maintaining cost control systems and procedures to track project budgets, commitments, expenditures, and forecasts.

• Working with the Integrated Project Team to establish a robust, integrated, well structured, accurate Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB) and support the change control process.

• Development of project Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS), align the time phasing of budgets against the Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), to accurately track and control actual costs.

• Map and integrate cost estimates to the Work Breakdown Structure, in order to set the project budget against the correct Work Packages, Planning Packages and Control Accounts.

• Adherence to NEC or FIDIC contract processes for management, control and reporting of cost data

• Lead the production of accruals to ensure that the Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP) is accurately reflected in a timely manner in the cost data.

• Support the change process by providing cost information for change notes and to underpin forecasts.

• Update project forecasts to ensure comprehensive and aligned Estimate To Complete (ETC).

• Work with the project team to set out and implement cost capture requirements, including ensuring appropriate work orders (WO) are in place, structure of requisitions, aligning Purchase Order (PO) structure with WO’s and ensuring sub contract data provided can be used to monitor and control costs

• Align Purchase Orders with CBS to give clarity of Cost Performance Indices at an appropriate level within the Project;     

• Validate and interrogate supply chain data to assist in accurate cost forecasting and trending and work with the supply chain to understand variances, drive cost accuracy and timely and accurate reporting

• Ability to interact with Management / Leadership members when delivering updates on Cost Control within a complex project/programme environment.

• Ability to guide and influence whilst delivering to cost control processes, on complex projects/programmes along with all associated processes & reports.

• Demonstrate leadership whilst developing technical ability of delivery and cost control team.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds - which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our largest customers bring us their support teams’ hardest problems, like a stolen card, a disputed payment or a patient asking about their prescription, in highly regulated environments and at volumes where small mistakes are expensive. Lorikeet's Concierge handles the full lifecycle of customer interactions across channels and systems, following each customer's policies and knowing when to tag in a human.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Product Manager, you'll own a small number of our most strategic accounts and the outcomes they drive from Concierge. You'll set the implementation plan with your Forward Deployed Engineer, get each customer live and keep uncovering expansion opportunities as their deployment scales. You'll be the partner that customer executives call, and you'll know their business and strategic priorities well enough to lead the decision of what Concierge takes on next.

The rest of the role is spent in the product, building, testing and deploying changes yourself. You'll also run each account as a business, growing usage against the contract and knowing where the next expansion opportunity will come from. You'll use Coach, our forward deployed agent, and Claude Code to investigate problems, test changes and ship improvements without relying on engineers for every change.

When you find a problem that keeps coming up across customers, you'll make sure we solve it once rather than five times, and turn what you've learned into playbooks and coaching for the FDPMs who follow you. You'll also help shape how we manage our largest customers as Lorikeet grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead deployments for our largest customers, aligning their executives and our engineers on priorities and what success looks like.

- Own a small number of strategic accounts after launch, including Concierge performance, usage of the product, retention and account growth.

- Investigate where Concierge can improve, build and deploy fixes into production, setting the deployment’s direction with your FDE.

- Find the next use case with each customer's executives and build the case for expansion.

- Get each deployment through the customer's procurement, security and legal reviews.

- Coach FDPMs and turn what you've learned into playbooks and tools.

- Bring Product the problems that matter most, backed by evidence from your customers, and follow them until they ship.

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Build a voice agent that books live currency trades over the phone, from checking the caller's identity to confirming the trade.

- Deploy Concierge as a fintech's 24/7 phone line, replacing cards and opening fraud cases without a human in the loop.

- Automate identity document checks for a money transfer app, catching forged documents faster than human reviewers.

- Invent a new way to verify a locked-out c

Help the team do the same by sharing what works, so AI removes execution barriers between disciplines and scales across the UX organization.

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Se você quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Especialista Financeiro, você irá somar ao time Transacional, que tem como objetivo garantir a integridade do fluxo ponta a ponta (transacional, financeiro e contábil), otimizar os custos e receitas de meios de pagamento e assegurar a acuracidade das conciliações e obrigações fiscais da companhia.
No dia a dia você vai:

• Fazer a manutenção da matriz de conciliação das contas gráficas da carteira e criar o book de evidências para os auditores externos. Cartas de Circularização e Invoice de custos com Adquirente.

• Garantir o Transacional (Logs do Gateway) ➔ Financeiro (Extrato Bancário) ➔ Contábil (Razão), explicando e corrigindo eventuais sobras ou faltas de caixa de forma autônoma e com reportando divergências. Identificando o descasamento, localizando a causa raiz e corrige o lançamento contábil e entrega da solução.

• Auditar os arquivos de retorno (extratos eletrônicos das adquirentes) para garantir que a taxa de MDR e antecipação acordada em contrato foi a efetivamente cobrada. Se a adquirente cobrou os valores acordados, monitorar o desempenho financeiro (receita, recebimento e custo) por método de pagamento (PIX, Boleto, Cartão, Nupay e etc.) por adquirente e parcelas.

• Extrair dados brutos de bancos de dados (via SQL/APIs de pagamento) e construção de cenários e análises em dashboard sobre a receita, recebimento e o custo de antecipação de recebíveis.

• Manutenção das bases de dados para a contabilização do resultado haja visto o processo de integração está em fase de construção. Executar e garantir assertividade das contabilizações dos saldos de receita, despesa e afins no ERP, eliminando possíveis distorções do resultado.

• Manter a gestão do processo de emissão unitária de NFe e adequações as demandas da Reforma Tributária.

• Acompanhar as ações dos times de Negócio, Tecnologia e Produtos com o viés de garantir a correta tratativa no CRM e ERP.

E o que você precisa ter?

• Domínio intermediário/avançado em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados brutos de bancos de dados e APIs de pagamento.

• Experiência no mercado de meios de pagamento on-line e multiadquirentes.

• Meios de pagamento: Experiência com reconciliação de adquirentes e gateways (fluxo de cartões, PIX, Boleto), leitura de arquivos EDI/CNAB e auditoria de taxas (MDR e Antecipação).

• Contabilidade e ERP: Sólido conhecimento em conciliação de contas gráficas, razão contábil e rotinas de ERPs de grande porte (SAP, Oracle, Totvs ou similares).

• Data & Analytics: Capacidade de construir dashboards financeiros (Power BI, Tableau ou Excel Avançado).

• Fiscal: Conhecimento em emissão de NF-e e impactos da Reforma Tributária.

• Autonomia para identificar descasamentos financeiros, localizar a causa raiz e corrigir lançamentos contábeis.

• Habilidade para alinhar processos e regras de negócio com os times de Tecnologia, Produto e CRM.

• Perfil extremamente analítico voltado para auditoria e compliance (geração de books de evidências).

Diferencial / Desejável:

• Certificações em Power BI/SQL, ou especialização em Controladoria/Fintechs.

• Inglês avançado.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant
Location: South Africa
Job Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)
Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)
We are looking for an exceptionally experienced, proactive, and highly capable Executive Assistant to provide direct support to a busy executive/founder.
This is not a role for someone who needs constant direction or waits to be told what to do. The ideal candidate will act as a true right-hand person - anticipating needs, taking ownership, making confident decisions, and getting things done quickly and efficiently.
You will be trusted to manage a combination of executive, business, administrative, and personal responsibilities, often working across multiple priorities at once. The successful candidate must be exceptionally responsive, organised, tech-savvy, discreet, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
Key Responsibilities

• Provide high-level executive and personal support to the executive/founder.

• Manage calendars, scheduling, appointments, and competing priorities.

• Coordinate meetings, follow-ups, reminders, and outstanding action items.

• Proactively follow up on tasks and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Handle both business and personal requests with professionalism and discretion.

• Manage purchases, orders, deliveries, and general logistics.

• Assist with administrative and credit-card-related tasks.

• Coordinate with internal and external contacts on behalf of the executive.

• Independently prioritise incoming requests and determine the appropriate next steps.

• Anticipate the executive's needs and take action before being asked.

• Keep track of multiple moving parts and provide timely updates.

• Resolve issues independently wherever possible rather than escalating every decision.

• Use technology and digital tools confidently to improve efficiency and organisation.

• Maintain a high level of confidentiality when dealing with sensitive personal and business information.

Requirements

• Previous Executive Assistant or Personal Assistant experience is essential.

• Proven experience directly supporting a busy executive, owner, founder, or senior leader.

• Demonstrated ability to manage both business and personal responsibilities.

• Strong calendar and scheduling management experience.

• Excellent organisational and follow-up skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Exceptional responsiveness and sense of urgency.

• Highly tech-savvy and comfortable learning and using new systems and software.

• Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Strong judgment and the confidence to make decisions without needing detailed instructions.

• Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

• Strong discretion and the ability to handle confidential information appropriately.

• Previous remote working experience is preferred.

• ABA, healthcare, or medical industry experience would be highly beneficial.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.
Let us walk you through the next steps.
Step 1 - Complete Your Application
Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.
Step 2 - The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)
This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!
Why do we ask for a video?
Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you . Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

• How you communicate and connect with people.

• How you present yourself professionally.

• Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your persona

title: Consumer Study Coordinator (Part-Time - 2nd shift) - Richmond, Virginia
description:
Celerion is committed to swift, exceptional clinical research through translational medicine.  Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get drugs to market faster.  

Celerion is currently seeking a part-time Consumer Study Coordinator at our Richmond, VA location. Our Richmond location focuses on consumer opinion studies related to nicotine and tobacco products.
 
This position is Part-time and will work around 20 hours per week. We are looking for candidates with the flexibility to work between the hours of 4:30pm-9:30pm, Monday-Friday based on business needs. Occasional morning and Saturday shifts are a possibility. 
 
As a Consumer Study Coordinator, you will be responsible for the preparation and maintenance of all stages of participant activities including screening, training, and evaluations. Duties include entering and updating study information into computer systems, collecting and organizing panelist’s paperwork and documentation, and developing positive participant communications and relationships.
 
Requirements
We are seeking candidates with great customer service, administrative skills and the ability to work a part-time flexible schedule. Consumer/market research experience is preferred. Ability to work in required work environment, including but not limited to exposure to second hand smoke from combustible cigarettes and vapors from electronic cigarettes on a daily basis. 
 
According to the Code of Virginia 18.2-371.2B, employees must be 21 years of age to work around tobacco products.

Celerion Values:       Integrity   Trust   Teamwork   Respect
 
Celerion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, qualified protected veteran status, or disability.

title: Certified Inpatient Medical Coder
description:
Role Title: Certified Inpatient Medical Coder
Role Type: Contractor
Location: United States, Remote
micro1 is engaging a Certified Inpatient Medical Coder to contribute to a customer's project focused on enhancing medical data accuracy and integrity. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.
Scope of Work

• Review and analyze inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding in alignment with current guidelines and best practices.

• Review clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and coding integrity.

• Identify principal and secondary diagnoses, sequence codes per the Official Guidelines, and assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators.

• Validate MS-DRG assignment, including identification of CCs and MCCs, and flag hospital-acquired conditions (HACs) and patient safety indicators.

• Evaluate AI-generated clinical notes and summaries against real-world documentation and coding standards.

• Code AI-generated diagnostic and procedural information from the record using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS classification systems.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in diagnosis and procedure coding, ensuring the integrity of record abstraction and data capture.

• Provide clear written feedback on coding errors and complex cases to improve model performance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active certification in one of the following: CIC or CCS, or other coding certification through AHIMA and AAPC (e.g., RHIA, RHIT, COC).

• Inpatient ICD-10-CM/PCS coding experience.

• Access to up-to-date official ICD-10-CM/PCS coding books and Coding Clinic guidance.

• Currently working in inpatient medical coding, clinical documentation improvement, or a closely related documentation role.

• Availability of at least 10 hours per week.
